ModMetaData.name: Trader Ships - Steampunk Airships
ModMetaData.author: AUTOMATIC; steampunk adaptation by Briana and Cinder
ModMetaData.description:
For RimWorld 1.7, eligible industrial factions share eight steampunk airship designs, a basket balloon and a brass helicopter with stock from their own faction's caravan trader kinds. Non-insect Archotech traders use a saucer. Eligible traders whose faction name, definition ID or label contains insect use an insectoid broodship; hostility and trade eligibility are unchanged. Spacer, Ultra and factionless orbital traders retain AUTOMATIC's original high-tech ships. Normal ground caravans remain available. Existing saved ships keep their stored appearance. The four additional families each have one finished broadside sprite; rotors and ropes are static artwork with native whole-craft flight animations.
Use this copy instead of the original Trader Ships, not alongside it. The 1.7 build requires the current 1.7 version of Harmony. Earlier version assemblies are retained separately; the faction-fleet routing is a 1.7 feature.
Medieval factions can also send balloon-and-basket traders using their own eligible trade stock. Tribal factions retain ground traders. No new faction, hostility change or additional arrival schedule is introduced.
Ships will visit your colony, preferring landing pads, and trade with you just like visiting caravans, without the need for trade beacons or comm console. Trader ships are meant to replace orbital traders, but you can set both to be active in settings.
